blocks.zh: 濾膜確效、設計與特性鑑定
blocks.en: Filter Qualification, Design, and Characterization

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解濾膜製造商與使用者在濾膜確效 (Filter Qualification) 與驗證 (Filter Validation) 中各自的責任劃分
blocks.en: Understand how responsibilities are divided between the filter manufacturer and the user for filter qualification and filter validation

blocks.zh: 認識不同濾膜設計型式（濾芯、囊式濾器、平片式）的結構特點與適用場景
blocks.en: Recognize the structural features and typical applications of the different filter formats (cartridge, capsule, disc)

blocks.zh: 理解可萃取物 (Extractables) 與可溶出物 (Leachables) 的定義、來源及其對藥品品質的影響
blocks.en: Understand the definitions and sources of extractables and leachables, and their impact on drug product quality

blocks.zh: 掌握濾膜化學相容性 (Chemical Compatibility)、生物相容性 (Biocompatibility)、操作範圍與保存期限的關鍵考量
blocks.en: Master the key considerations for chemical compatibility, biocompatibility, operational ranges, and shelf life

blocks.zh: 學會如何將一次性使用系統 (Single-Use System) 整合於除菌過濾操作中的優勢與風險評估
blocks.en: Learn the advantages and risk assessment considerations of integrating single-use systems into sterilizing filtration operations

blocks.zh: 4.0 Filter Qualification, Design, and Characterization 4.0 過濾器確效、設計與特性分析
blocks.en: 4.0 Filter Qualification, Design, and Characterization

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Sterilizing-Grade Filter (除菌級濾膜)：指經過驗證能夠完全攔截微生物（特別是 Brevundimonas diminuta，挑戰密度至少 107 CFU/cm2）的 0.2 微米（或更小）孔徑濾膜。這是無菌製程中最關鍵的最後一道防線。
blocks.en: Sterilizing-Grade Filter: A membrane filter with a pore size of 0.2 micron (or smaller) that has been validated to completely retain microorganisms (in particular Brevundimonas diminuta, at a challenge level of at least 107 CFU/cm2). It is the most critical last line of defense in aseptic processing.

blocks.zh: Filter Qualification (濾膜確效)：由濾膜製造商執行的一系列標準化測試，證明濾膜適合藥品應用。包含細菌攔截、完整性測試、可萃取物、生物相容性等。
blocks.en: Filter Qualification: A series of standardized tests performed by the filter manufacturer to demonstrate that the filter is suitable for pharmaceutical applications. It includes bacterial retention, integrity testing, extractables, biocompatibility, and more.

blocks.zh: Membrane Chemistry (濾膜化學材質)：不同高分子材料（PVDF、PES、Nylon 等）各有不同的流速特性、化學相容性和萃取物特性。選擇時須綜合考量製程需求。
blocks.en: Membrane Chemistry: Different polymers (PVDF, PES, nylon, etc.) each have their own flow rate characteristics, chemical compatibility, and extractables profile. The choice must take the process requirements into account.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 選擇濾膜就像選擇淨水器的濾芯。市面上有活性碳、RO 逆滲透、中空纖維等不同類型，每種都有不同的過濾效果、流量和壽命。你不會只看價格就買 -- 你要考慮水質（製程液特性）、用水量（批量大小）、過濾後是否會釋放異味（可萃取物）等。同樣地，濾膜製造商提供的技術文件就像淨水器的檢驗報告，但你還是要在自家水管系統中實際測試才能確認效果。
blocks.en: Choosing a filter membrane is like choosing a water purifier cartridge. There are different types on the market (activated carbon, reverse osmosis, hollow fiber), each with different filtration performance, flow rate, and service life. You would not buy on price alone -- you would consider the water quality (characteristics of the process fluid), the water volume (batch size), and whether the filter might release an odor afterwards (extractables). Likewise, the technical documents supplied by the filter manufacturer are like the test report for a water purifier, but you still have to test it on your own plumbing to confirm it works.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 責任劃分很重要：濾膜製造商負責「確效」(Qualification)，證明產品本身的品質與性能；濾膜使用者則負責「驗證」(Validation)，證明在自己的實際製程條件下，濾膜仍能達到預期的除菌效能。製造商的文件是基礎，但不能取代使用者自己的驗證工作。
blocks.en: The division of responsibilities matters: The filter manufacturer is responsible for "qualification", demonstrating the quality and performance of the product itself; the filter user is responsible for "validation", demonstrating that the filter still achieves the intended sterilizing performance under the user's actual process conditions. The manufacturer's documentation is the foundation, but it cannot replace the user's own validation work.

blocks.zh: FDA DMF (Drug Master File)：這是濾膜製造商向 FDA 提交的機密文件，包含完整的製造與品質資訊。藥廠在提交 NDA/BLA 時可以引用此 DMF，無需自行提供這些細節。
blocks.en: FDA DMF (Drug Master File): A confidential document that the filter manufacturer submits to the FDA, containing complete manufacturing and quality information. A drug manufacturer can reference this DMF in an NDA/BLA submission and does not need to provide these details itself.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼本節特別強調 bacterial retention 和 integrity testing 將在後續章節（Section 6.0 與 7.0）另外討論？這暗示了這兩項測試在整體濾膜驗證中的什麼地位？
blocks.en: Why does this section stress that bacterial retention and integrity testing will be discussed separately in later sections (Section 6.0 and Section 7.0)? What does this imply about the standing of these two tests within overall filter validation?

blocks.zh: 假設你是 CDMO 的品質人員，客戶指定使用特定品牌的 PES 濾膜。你會向濾膜製造商索取哪些關鍵文件來開始你的評估？
blocks.en: Suppose you are a quality professional at a CDMO and your client specifies a particular brand of PES filter. Which key documents would you request from the filter manufacturer to start your evaluation?

blocks.zh: 4.1 Filter Qualification and Validation 4.1 過濾器確效與驗證
blocks.en: 4.1 Filter Qualification and Validation

blocks.zh: Q、L、V、E 四層責任架構：
blocks.en: The Q, L, V, E four-level responsibility framework:

blocks.zh: Q (Qualification，確效)：濾膜製造商執行的標準化測試，建立產品的基本品質數據
blocks.en: Q (Qualification): Standardized tests performed by the filter manufacturer that establish the basic quality data for the product

blocks.zh: L (Lot Release，批次放行)：製造商對每批出廠產品的放行檢驗，確保批間一致性
blocks.en: L (Lot Release): The manufacturer's release testing of every lot shipped, ensuring lot-to-lot consistency

blocks.zh: V (Validation，驗證)：使用者必須執行的製程驗證，證明在實際製程條件下的效能
blocks.en: V (Validation): Process validation that the user must perform to demonstrate performance under actual process conditions

blocks.zh: E (Evaluate，評估)：使用者需評估是否需要額外測試，並記錄技術評估理由
blocks.en: E (Evaluate): The user must evaluate whether additional testing is needed and document the technical rationale

blocks.zh: ASTM F838：這是細菌攔截測試的標準方法，使用 Brevundimonas diminuta 作為挑戰菌株，建立完整性測試與細菌攔截之間的關聯性。
blocks.en: ASTM F838: The standard method for bacterial retention testing. It uses Brevundimonas diminuta as the challenge organism and establishes the correlation between integrity testing and bacterial retention.

blocks.zh: Table 4.1-1🔍 的責任分工就像買車：汽車製造商（濾膜廠）負責出廠前的碰撞測試、排放檢驗、品質管控（Q, L）。但車主（濾膜使用者）買車後還是要做：實際路況試駕（V = 製程驗證）、評估是否需要加裝行車記錄器或改裝排氣管（E = 評估額外測試需求）。製造商說車子「可以開」不代表「在你的路線上可以安全開」-- 那是車主的責任。
blocks.en: The division of responsibilities in Table 4.1-1🔍 is like buying a car: the car manufacturer (the filter maker) is responsible for crash tests, emissions tests, and quality control before the car leaves the factory (Q, L). But after buying the car, the owner (the filter user) still has to do a test drive on real roads (V = process validation) and decide whether to add a dash cam or modify the exhaust (E = evaluating the need for additional testing). The manufacturer saying the car "can be driven" does not mean it "can be driven safely on your route" -- that is the owner's responsibility.

blocks.zh: Extractables vs. Leachables 的關鍵差異：
blocks.en: Key differences between extractables and leachables:

blocks.zh: 可萃取物 (Extractables)：在極端實驗條件（強溶劑、高溫、長時間）下從濾膜中「強制」萃取出來的化學物質 -- 代表「最壞情況」的完整清單
blocks.en: Extractables: Chemical substances that are "forcibly" extracted from the filter under extreme laboratory conditions (strong solvents, high temperature, long duration) -- a complete "worst-case" inventory

blocks.zh: 可溶出物 (Leachables)：在正常製程條件下實際遷移到產品中的化學物質 -- 通常是可萃取物的一個子集 (subset)
blocks.en: Leachables: Chemical substances that actually migrate into the product under normal process conditions -- typically a subset of the extractables

blocks.zh: Leachables 研究應以 extractables 研究結果為基礎來設計，而非從零開始。這是一個科學驅動的漸進式方法。
blocks.en: A leachables study should be designed based on the results of the extractables study rather than starting from scratch. This is a science-driven, stepwise approach.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務情境：當你的客戶要求更換濾膜供應商時，Table 4.1-1🔍 就是你的檢查清單。你需要：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: When your client asks you to change filter suppliers, Table 4.1-1🔍 is your checklist. You need to:

blocks.zh: 向新供應商索取所有標示 Q 和 L 的測試數據
blocks.en: Request from the new supplier all test data marked Q and L

blocks.zh: 重新執行所有標示 V 的製程驗證（不能沿用舊濾膜的數據）
blocks.en: Repeat all process validation marked V (data from the old filter cannot be carried over)

blocks.zh: 對所有標示 E 的項目進行風險評估，決定哪些需要重新測試
blocks.en: Perform a risk assessment on all items marked E to decide which need to be retested

blocks.zh: 這個變更可能需要 3-6 個月和數十萬的費用 -- 因此供應商選擇應該在製程開發早期就慎重考量。
blocks.en: This change may take 3-6 months and cost hundreds of thousands of dollars -- so supplier selection should be considered carefully early in process development.

blocks.zh: 在 Table 4.1-1🔍 中，為什麼 "Bacteria Retention in Product" 只有使用者需要做 (V)，而製造商不做 (-)?
blocks.en: In Table 4.1-1🔍, why is "Bacteria Retention in Product" performed only by the user (V) and not by the manufacturer (-)?

blocks.zh: 如果可萃取物研究顯示某種化合物含量極低，你是否可以跳過可溶出物研究？你的風險評估邏輯會是什麼？
blocks.en: If an extractables study shows that a compound is present at a very low level, can you skip the leachables study? What would your risk assessment logic be?

blocks.zh: "Biological reactivity" 測試為什麼不需要使用者重複執行？這與其他測試項目有何不同？
blocks.en: Why does the user not need to repeat the "Biological reactivity" tests? How does this differ from the other test items?

blocks.zh: 4.2 Filter Design 4.2 過濾器設計
blocks.en: 4.2 Filter Design

blocks.zh: EFA (Effective Filtration Area，有效過濾面積)：這是濾膜中實際參與過濾的表面積。透過褶皺 (pleating) 設計，可在有限的濾器外殼空間內大幅增加有效面積。EFA 直接決定了流速和總處理量。
blocks.en: EFA (Effective Filtration Area): The membrane surface area that actually takes part in filtration. Pleating makes it possible to greatly increase the effective area within the limited space of the filter housing. EFA directly determines flow rate and total throughput.

blocks.zh: 濾器三大型式：
blocks.en: The three main filter formats:

blocks.zh: Cartridge (濾芯)：安裝在不鏽鋼外殼中，可更換內芯，適合大規模生產
blocks.en: Cartridge: Installed in a stainless steel housing with a replaceable element; suited to large-scale production

blocks.zh: Capsule (囊式濾器)：濾膜預裝在塑膠外殼中的一體式設計，使用後整體丟棄，屬於一次性使用 (Single-Use)
blocks.en: Capsule: An integrated design with the membrane pre-installed in a plastic housing; the whole unit is discarded after use, so it is single-use

blocks.zh: Disc (平片式)：用於實驗室或小規模測試
blocks.en: Disc: Used for laboratory or small-scale testing

blocks.zh: T-Style vs. In-Line Style：兩種外殼進出口配置。T-style 的進出口在底部同側（便於排液），In-line style 的進口在頂部、出口在底部（利用重力排空）。
blocks.en: T-Style vs. In-Line Style: Two housing inlet/outlet configurations. In the T-style, the inlet and outlet are on the same side at the bottom (convenient for draining); in the in-line style, the inlet is at the top and the outlet at the bottom (draining by gravity).

blocks.zh: 褶皺密度的平衡就像摺扇：把扇面摺得太密（pleat density 太高），扇子打不開、扇不到風（流路受限）；摺得太疏（pleat density 太低），扇面面積太小，扇風效果也不好。最佳設計是在有限的空間裡找到摺皺密度的甜蜜點，讓空氣（液體）能自由流過，同時最大化有效面積。
blocks.en: Balancing pleat density is like folding a hand fan: if the fan is folded too tightly (pleat density too high), it cannot open and moves no air (restricted flow path); if folded too loosely (pleat density too low), the fan surface is too small and also moves little air. The best design finds the sweet spot of pleat density within the limited space, so that air (the liquid) can flow through freely while the effective area is maximized.

blocks.zh: 而 adapter（轉接頭）就像電器插頭：即使電器再好，如果插頭和插座不匹配、接觸不良，輕則漏電（洩漏），重則起火（無菌保證失敗）。雙 O-ring 雙卡榫設計就是「防呆+雙保險」的概念。
blocks.en: An adapter is like an electrical plug: no matter how good the appliance is, if the plug and socket do not match or make poor contact, the best case is a short (leakage) and the worst case is a fire (failure of sterility assurance). The double O-ring, double-lug design is a "mistake-proofing plus double safeguard" concept.

blocks.zh: Scale-Up 的陷阱：製程開發階段使用的小型濾器與量產階段的大型濾器可能有不同的褶皺幾何設計。高 EFA 褶皺通常只用在量產設備上。這意味著 PD 階段的流速和處理量數據可能無法直接外推到量產規模 -- 需要在量產設備上重新評估。
blocks.en: The scale-up trap: The small filters used in process development and the large filters used in commercial production may have different pleat geometries. High-EFA pleat designs are usually used only in production-scale equipment. This means that flow rate and throughput data from the PD stage may not be directly extrapolated to production scale -- they need to be re-evaluated on the production equipment.

blocks.zh: 密封的全程完整性：注意原文強調密封必須在整個操作過程中維持 -- 從 SIP（就地滅菌，高溫高壓條件）一直到使用後完整性測試。這涵蓋了極端的溫度和壓力變化，對密封材料和設計是很大的挑戰。
blocks.en: Seal integrity throughout: Note that the source text stresses that the seal must be maintained throughout the entire operation -- from SIP (steam-in-place, with high temperature and pressure) all the way to post-use integrity testing. This spans extreme changes in temperature and pressure and is a major challenge for sealing materials and design.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure Analysis
blocks.en: Figure Analysis

blocks.zh: Figures 4.2-1 ~ 4.2-7（原文配圖）：本節引用了大量圖片展示不同濾器結構。重點理解：
blocks.en: Figures 4.2-1 to 4.2-7 (figures in the source text): This section cites many figures showing different filter constructions. The key points to understand are:

blocks.zh: Figure 4.2-1🔍：Cartridge（需搭配不鏽鋼外殼）、Capsule（自帶外殼、一體式）、各組件分解圖
blocks.en: Figure 4.2-1🔍: Cartridge (requires a stainless steel housing), capsule (self-contained, integrated housing), and exploded views of the components

blocks.zh: Figure 4.2-3🔍/4.2-4：剖面圖顯示液體流向 -- 從外向內穿過褶皺膜，匯入中央核心後流出
blocks.en: Figure 4.2-3🔍/4.2-4: Cross-sections showing the direction of liquid flow -- from the outside inward through the pleated membrane, into the central core, and out

blocks.zh: Figure 4.2-5🔍/4.2-6：T-style（進出口同側底部）vs. In-line style（進口頂部、出口底部）
blocks.en: Figure 4.2-5🔍/4.2-6: T-style (inlet and outlet on the same side at the bottom) vs. in-line style (inlet at the top, outlet at the bottom)

blocks.zh: Figure 4.2-7🔍：不同 adapter 型式 -- 選錯型號會造成密封不良的嚴重後果
blocks.en: Figure 4.2-7🔍: Different adapter types -- choosing the wrong one can lead to a poor seal with serious consequences

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下你會選擇 capsule（囊式濾器）而不是 cartridge（濾芯+不鏽鋼外殼）？從成本、驗證、操作便利性三個維度分析。
blocks.en: Under what circumstances would you choose a capsule rather than a cartridge (with stainless steel housing)? Analyze from three perspectives: cost, validation, and operational convenience.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 vent port（排氣口）在濾器設計中很重要？如果空氣沒有完全排除，會對過濾操作和完整性測試造成什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why is the vent port important in filter design? If air is not completely removed, what effect will it have on the filtration operation and integrity testing?

blocks.zh: 4.3 Filters in Single-Use Disposable Systems 4.3 單次使用拋棄式系統中的過濾器
blocks.en: 4.3 Filters in Single-Use Disposable Systems

blocks.zh: Single-Use System, SUS (一次性使用系統)：預先組裝、預先滅菌（通常用 gamma 或 x-ray 輻射）的濾器與管路組件。使用一次後即丟棄，不需清洗、不需 CIP/SIP。
blocks.en: Single-Use System (SUS): Pre-assembled, pre-sterilized (usually by gamma or x-ray irradiation) filter and tubing assemblies. They are discarded after one use, with no cleaning and no CIP/SIP required.

blocks.zh: Hybrid System (混合系統)：結合不鏽鋼設備與一次性組件的系統。例如使用不鏽鋼配液桶搭配一次性管路與囊式濾器。這是許多 CDMO 目前最常見的配置。
blocks.en: Hybrid System: A system that combines stainless steel equipment with single-use components, for example a stainless steel formulation tank used with single-use tubing and capsule filters. This is currently the most common configuration at many CDMOs.

blocks.zh: Ready-to-Use Assembly (即用型組件)：由供應商預先組裝好的完整過濾系統，包含濾器、管路、接頭、感測器等，經 gamma 輻射滅菌後出貨，現場拆封即可使用。
blocks.en: Ready-to-Use Assembly: A complete filtration system pre-assembled by the supplier, including filters, tubing, connectors, sensors, and so on, shipped after gamma irradiation sterilization and ready to use once unpacked on site.

blocks.zh: 不鏽鋼濾器系統就像家裡的瓷器餐具：品質好、可重複使用，但每次用完要洗、要消毒、要檢查有沒有破損，而且洗碗（清洗驗證）本身就是一項大工程。一次性使用系統就像免洗餐具：開封即用、用完即丟，不用洗碗，也不用擔心上一批客人的菜汁殘留（交叉污染）。但免洗餐具有環保問題（廢棄物），而且你需要確認免洗餐具本身沒有釋放有害物質（可萃取物/可溶出物）。
blocks.en: A stainless steel filter system is like ceramic tableware at home: good quality and reusable, but after every use it has to be washed, disinfected, and checked for damage, and the washing itself (cleaning validation) is a major undertaking. A single-use system is like disposable tableware: open it and use it, throw it away afterwards, with no dishwashing and no worry about leftover food from the previous guest (cross-contamination). But disposable tableware has an environmental cost (waste), and you need to confirm that the disposable tableware itself does not release harmful substances (extractables/leachables).

blocks.zh: SUS 的隱藏成本：雖然 SUS 省去了清洗驗證和設備折舊，但有其他成本需考量：
blocks.en: The hidden costs of SUS: Although SUS eliminates cleaning validation and equipment depreciation, there are other costs to consider:

blocks.zh: 廢棄物處理成本：大量塑膠廢棄物的處理和環保合規
blocks.en: Waste disposal cost: Handling large amounts of plastic waste and environmental compliance

blocks.zh: 供應鏈風險：對特定供應商的依賴性增加，如遇供應中斷可能影響生產
blocks.en: Supply chain risk: Greater dependence on specific suppliers; a supply interruption could affect production

blocks.zh: 可萃取物/可溶出物評估：塑膠組件需要額外的 E&L 研究
blocks.en: Extractables/leachables assessment: Plastic components require additional E&L studies

blocks.zh: 儲存空間：預滅菌組件需要乾淨、溫控的倉儲空間
blocks.en: Storage space: Pre-sterilized components need clean, temperature-controlled warehouse space

blocks.zh: PDA TR-66 提供了 SUS 實施的完整指引，在引進 SUS 前應詳細參考。
blocks.en: PDA TR-66 provides complete guidance on implementing SUS and should be consulted in detail before introducing SUS.

blocks.zh: CDMO 多產品生產的決策：CDMO 同時生產多種藥品，交叉污染風險是最大挑戰之一。使用 SUS 可以從根本上消除交叉污染風險（每批使用全新組件），同時大幅縮短批次間的轉換時間（不需 CIP/SIP）。對於高效價藥物（如 ADC、高活性 API），SUS 幾乎是必要的選擇。但對於大批量、低價值產品，不鏽鋼系統的長期經濟性可能更佳。
blocks.en: Decision-making for CDMO multi-product manufacturing: A CDMO produces many different drug products at the same time, so the risk of cross-contamination is one of the biggest challenges. Using SUS can eliminate cross-contamination risk at its root (brand-new components for every batch) and also greatly shorten changeover time between batches (no CIP/SIP). For highly potent drugs (such as ADCs and highly potent APIs), SUS is almost a necessity. For large-volume, low-value products, however, a stainless steel system may be more economical in the long run.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在評估是否將一條傳統不鏽鋼充填線轉換為 hybrid system。列出你會考量的前三大風險因素和前三大效益。
blocks.en: Your CDMO is evaluating whether to convert a traditional stainless steel filling line to a hybrid system. List the top three risk factors and the top three benefits you would consider.

blocks.zh: 原文提到可以基於 "environment (waste), energy use, or financial analysis" 進行不同的最佳化。在 ESG（環境、社會、治理）越來越受重視的今天，這對 CDMO 的 SUS 採購策略有什麼影響？
blocks.en: The source text mentions that different optimizations can be made based on "environment (waste), energy use, or financial analysis". Now that ESG (environmental, social, and governance) is receiving ever more attention, what does this mean for a CDMO's SUS procurement strategy?

blocks.zh: 4.4 Filter Toxicity and Biocompatibility 4.4 過濾器毒性與生物相容性
blocks.en: 4.4 Filter Toxicity and Biocompatibility

blocks.zh: Biocompatibility (生物相容性)：濾膜材料與生物體接觸時不產生有害反應的能力。這是藥品安全的基本要求 -- 濾膜本身不能成為毒性物質的來源。
blocks.en: Biocompatibility: The ability of the filter material to avoid causing harmful reactions when in contact with biological systems. This is a basic requirement for drug product safety -- the filter itself must not become a source of toxic substances.

blocks.zh: Toxicity Testing (毒性測試)：依據藥典方法（如 USP <87> 體外細胞毒性試驗、USP <88> 體內生物反應性試驗），將濾膜萃取液或樣品暴露於細胞培養系統，觀察細胞反應來評估毒性。
blocks.en: Toxicity Testing: Following pharmacopoeial methods (such as USP <87> in vitro cytotoxicity test and USP <88> in vivo biological reactivity test), filter extracts or samples are exposed to cell culture systems and the cellular response is observed to assess toxicity.

blocks.zh: TSE (Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies，可傳播性海綿狀腦病變)：如牛海綿狀腦病（BSE，俗稱狂牛症）。任何使用動物來源材料的產品都需評估 TSE 傳播風險。
blocks.en: TSE (Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies): For example bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE, commonly known as mad cow disease). Any product that uses animal-derived materials must be assessed for the risk of TSE transmission.

blocks.zh: 生物相容性測試就像食品容器的安全檢測：你家微波爐用的塑膠容器必須通過食品級安全測試，確認加熱後不會釋放有害物質到食物中。同樣地，濾膜在接觸高價值藥品液流時，不能釋放任何對患者有毒的物質。而動物來源成分的追溯就像食品的產銷履歷 -- 你需要知道原料來源，確保沒有傳染性風險。
blocks.en: Biocompatibility testing is like safety testing for food containers: the plastic container used in your microwave must pass food-grade safety tests to confirm that it will not release harmful substances into the food when heated. Likewise, when a filter is in contact with a high-value drug product stream, it must not release anything toxic to patients. Traceability of animal-derived components is like food traceability labeling -- you need to know the source of the raw materials to make sure there is no risk of infectivity.

blocks.zh: 動物來源材料的法規趨勢：
blocks.en: Regulatory trends for animal-derived materials:

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 和 ICH Q5A 對動物來源材料有嚴格的追溯和風險評估要求
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 and ICH Q5A set strict traceability and risk assessment requirements for animal-derived materials

blocks.zh: 業界正在從動物實驗轉向細胞培養等替代方法，這是全球 3Rs（Replacement, Reduction, Refinement）原則的體現
blocks.en: The industry is moving from animal testing to alternative methods such as cell culture, in line with the global 3Rs principles (Replacement, Reduction, Refinement)

blocks.zh: 牛脂來源的硬脂酸鹽 (bovine tallow-derived stearates) 雖然 TSE 風險極低，但仍需在文件中記錄風險評估
blocks.en: Although the TSE risk of bovine tallow-derived stearates is extremely low, the risk assessment must still be documented

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的實際影響：某些客戶（特別是疫苗或生物製劑廠商）可能要求完全無動物來源成分 (Animal-Free) 的濾膜。確認供應商能提供相關聲明文件。
blocks.en: Practical impact for CDMOs: Some clients (particularly vaccine or biologics manufacturers) may require filters that are completely free of animal-derived components (animal-free). Confirm that the supplier can provide the relevant declaration documents.

blocks.zh: 為什麼毒性測試（biological reactivity）由製造商完成後，使用者不需要重複執行？對比 Table 4.1-1🔍 中其他測試項目的責任歸屬，說明原因。
blocks.en: Why does the user not need to repeat toxicity testing (biological reactivity) once the manufacturer has completed it? Compare with the responsibility allocation of the other test items in Table 4.1-1🔍 and explain the reason.

blocks.zh: 如果你的客戶要求所有製程接觸材料必須是 "Animal-Free"，你需要確認濾膜的哪些組件和文件？
blocks.en: If your client requires that all process-contact materials be "Animal-Free", which filter components and documents do you need to confirm?

blocks.zh: 4.5 Filter Cleanliness 4.5 過濾器潔淨度
blocks.en: 4.5 Filter Cleanliness

blocks.zh: Particulate Matter in Injections (注射劑微粒物質)：依 USP <788> / Ph. Eur. 2.9.19 標準，注射劑中 ≥10 μm 微粒不得超過 6000 個/容器（大容量注射劑），≥25 μm 不得超過 600 個/容器。濾膜沖洗液必須符合這些限度。
blocks.en: Particulate Matter in Injections: Under USP <788> / Ph. Eur. 2.9.19, injections must contain no more than 6000 particles ≥10 μm per container and no more than 600 particles ≥25 μm per container (large-volume injections). Filter flush effluent must meet these limits.

blocks.zh: Nonfiber-Releasing (非纖維釋放型)：確認濾膜在過濾操作中不會釋放纖維到濾液中。這是藥典的基本要求。
blocks.en: Nonfiber-Releasing: Confirms that the filter does not release fibers into the filtrate during filtration. This is a basic pharmacopoeial requirement.

blocks.zh: Preflushing (預沖洗)：在正式過濾前用水或適當溶劑沖洗濾膜，以去除殘留微粒、製造殘留物和表面活性劑等。沖洗量應基於可萃取物研究來決定。
blocks.en: Preflushing: Flushing the filter with water or a suitable solvent before actual filtration to remove residual particles, manufacturing residues, surfactants, and so on. The flush volume should be determined based on extractables studies.

blocks.zh: 預沖洗就像新買的水壺第一次使用前要先煮幾壺水倒掉：新水壺內壁可能有製造過程中的殘留物質（塑膠味、金屬粉末等），前幾壺水會把這些東西沖掉。同樣地，新濾膜上可能殘留製造過程中的添加劑、表面活性劑或微粒，預沖洗就是把這些「出廠殘留」清除乾淨，確保正式過濾時產品不會被污染。沖多少量（flush volume）要根據實驗數據決定，就像水壺要煮幾壺水才沒味道，要自己測試才知道。
blocks.en: Preflushing is like running a few kettles of water through a new kettle and pouring them away before first use: the inside wall of a new kettle may carry residues from manufacturing (a plastic smell, metal dust, etc.), and the first few kettles wash these away. Likewise, a new filter may carry additives, surfactants, or particles left over from manufacturing, and preflushing removes these "factory residues" so that the product is not contaminated during actual filtration. The flush volume must be decided from experimental data, just as you have to test for yourself how many kettles of water it takes before the smell is gone.

blocks.zh: 汙染源的全面考量：原文特別指出微粒汙染不只來自濾膜本身，還包括：
blocks.en: A comprehensive view of contamination sources: The source text specifically points out that particulate contamination comes not only from the filter itself, but also from:

blocks.zh: Filter hardware：不鏽鋼外殼、O-ring、adapter 等硬體組件
blocks.en: Filter hardware: Stainless steel housings, O-rings, adapters, and other hardware components

blocks.zh: Filter installation：安裝過程中引入的微粒（操作人員、工具、環境）
blocks.en: Filter installation: Particles introduced during installation (operators, tools, environment)

blocks.zh: Process：製程本身產生的微粒
blocks.en: Process: Particles generated by the process itself

blocks.zh: 這提醒我們在微粒調查時不能只聚焦在濾膜上 -- 整個系統都要評估。內毒素 (endotoxin) 和有機碳 (TOC) 也是需要關注的清潔度指標。
blocks.en: This is a reminder that a particulate investigation must not focus on the filter alone -- the whole system has to be evaluated. Endotoxin and total organic carbon (TOC) are also cleanliness indicators that need attention.

blocks.zh: 為什麼預沖洗通常與潤濕 (wetting) 步驟結合在完整性測試之前執行？這個操作順序的邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: Why is preflushing usually combined with the wetting step and performed before integrity testing? What is the logic behind this sequence of operations?

blocks.zh: 如果濾膜經 gamma 輻射滅菌後的可萃取物比蒸汽滅菌後更高，這對預沖洗量的設定有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If the extractables from a filter after gamma irradiation sterilization are higher than after steam sterilization, how does this affect the setting of the preflush volume?

blocks.zh: 4.6 Filter Extractables 4.6 過濾器可葦出物
blocks.en: 4.6 Filter Extractables

blocks.zh: Extractables (可萃取物)：在人為加強條件（強溶劑、高溫、長時間）下從材料中被萃取出來的化學物質。這是「最壞情況」的全面清單。
blocks.en: Extractables: Chemical substances extracted from a material under deliberately intensified conditions (strong solvents, high temperature, long duration). This is a comprehensive "worst-case" inventory.

blocks.zh: Leachables (可溶出物)：在正常使用或儲存條件下，從接觸表面遷移到藥品中的化學物質。通常是可萃取物的子集 -- 也就是說，在正常條件下實際會跑出來的量比極端條件下少很多。
blocks.en: Leachables: Chemical substances that migrate from a contact surface into the drug product under normal use or storage conditions. They are typically a subset of the extractables -- that is, the amounts that actually come out under normal conditions are much lower than under extreme conditions.

blocks.zh: Volume-to-Area Ratio (體積面積比)：製程液體體積與濾膜接觸面積的比值。比值越小（少量液體接觸大面積濾膜），單位體積中的可溶出物濃度可能越高。
blocks.en: Volume-to-Area Ratio: The ratio of the volume of process fluid to the membrane contact area. The smaller the ratio (a small volume of liquid in contact with a large membrane area), the higher the concentration of leachables per unit volume may be.

blocks.zh: Flush Curve (沖洗曲線)：以 TOC 或特定分析方法監測沖洗液中萃取物濃度隨沖洗量變化的趨勢。當曲線降至可接受水平時，即可停止預沖洗。
blocks.en: Flush Curve: A plot of the extractables concentration in the flush effluent against flush volume, monitored by TOC or a specific analytical method. When the curve falls to an acceptable level, preflushing can be stopped.

blocks.zh: Extractables 和 Leachables 的關係就像洗車：如果你用高壓水槍加清潔劑猛沖（極端條件 = extractables），車身上所有能被沖下來的東西都會下來 -- 灰塵、鳥糞、蠟層、甚至一點點漆。但如果只是下一場普通小雨（正常使用條件 = leachables），可能只會沖掉表面的灰塵。所以 leachables 通常是 extractables 的子集。但你做 extractables 測試的目的就是要先知道「最壞情況」，再來評估「正常情況」的風險。
blocks.en: The relationship between extractables and leachables is like washing a car: if you blast it with a high-pressure water jet and detergent (extreme conditions = extractables), everything that can come off the car will come off -- dust, bird droppings, the wax layer, even a little paint. But if it is just an ordinary light rain (normal use conditions = leachables), perhaps only the surface dust is washed off. So leachables are typically a subset of extractables. But the purpose of extractables testing is to first know the "worst case" and then assess the risk under "normal conditions".

blocks.zh: 有機溶劑的特殊風險：原文指出過濾有機溶液可能導致更高水平的可溶出物。這對使用有機溶劑的製程（如某些小分子藥物的最終過濾步驟）尤為重要。濾膜材質的選擇和 E&L 研究設計都需要特別考量。
blocks.en: The special risk of organic solvents: The source text notes that filtering organic solutions may lead to higher levels of leachables. This is especially important for processes that use organic solvents (such as the final filtration step of some small-molecule drugs). Both the choice of membrane material and the design of the E&L study need special consideration.

blocks.zh: 患者安全是最終考量：是否需要執行可溶出物研究，最終取決於對患者安全的風險評估。即使可萃取物水平看起來很低，如果其中包含已知的致癌物或基因毒性物質，仍需進行詳細的可溶出物研究。這再次印證了決策層級中「無菌保證/患者安全」永遠排在第一位。
blocks.en: Patient safety is the ultimate consideration: Whether a leachables study is needed ultimately depends on a risk assessment of patient safety. Even if the extractables levels appear low, if they include known carcinogens or genotoxic substances, a detailed leachables study is still required. This again confirms that "sterility assurance/patient safety" always ranks first in the decision hierarchy.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh: E&L 風險評估的關鍵變數：
blocks.en: Key variables for E&L risk assessment:

blocks.zh:
可溶出物風險 = f(萃取物種類, 接觸時間, 溫度,
                溶劑強度, 體積面積比, 滅菌方法)

實際可溶出物濃度 (估算) =
  萃取物總量 x 萃取效率因子 x (接觸時間/萃取時間)
  ÷ 藥品體積

其中：有機溶劑的萃取效率因子 > 水溶液的萃取效率因子
blocks.en:
Leachables risk = f(extractable species, contact time, temperature,
                solvent strength, volume-to-area ratio, sterilization method)

Actual leachables concentration (estimate) =
  total extractables x extraction efficiency factor x (contact time / extraction time)
  ÷ drug product volume

Where: the extraction efficiency factor for organic solvents > the extraction efficiency factor for aqueous solutions

blocks.zh: 為什麼原文說「leachables are typically a subset of extractables」？在什麼罕見情況下，可能會出現不在 extractables 清單中的 leachables？
blocks.en: Why does the source text say "leachables are typically a subset of extractables"? In what rare situations might leachables appear that are not on the extractables list?

blocks.zh: 你正在設計一個小批量生物製劑的除菌過濾步驟，批量只有 5L，但使用了標準 10 吋濾芯。從 volume-to-area ratio 的角度，你應該擔心什麼？如何緩解這個風險？
blocks.en: You are designing the sterilizing filtration step for a small-batch biologic. The batch is only 5 L, but a standard 10-inch cartridge is used. From the volume-to-area ratio perspective, what should you be concerned about, and how would you mitigate the risk?

blocks.zh: 4.6.1 Chemical Compatibility 4.6.1 化學相容性
blocks.en: 4.6.1 Chemical Compatibility

blocks.zh: Chemical Compatibility (化學相容性)：濾膜及其所有組件（膜材、外殼、O-ring、支撐層等）與製程液體在實際操作條件下不發生有害化學反應的能力。不相容可能導致：
blocks.en: Chemical Compatibility: The ability of the filter and all of its components (membrane, housing, O-rings, support layers, etc.) to avoid harmful chemical reactions with the process fluid under actual operating conditions. Incompatibility can lead to:

blocks.zh: 濾膜結構受損 → 細菌攔截失敗
blocks.en: Damage to the filter structure → failure of bacterial retention

blocks.zh: 萃取物/微粒增加 → 產品污染
blocks.en: Increased extractables/particles → product contamination

blocks.zh: 完整性測試失敗 → 批次報廢
blocks.en: Integrity test failure → batch rejection

blocks.zh: Entire Device（整個裝置）：強調不能只測試濾膜本身，還要包括 O-ring、外殼、端蓋等所有接觸零件。往往是非膜材組件（如 O-ring）最容易出現相容性問題。
blocks.en: Entire Device: Emphasizes that it is not enough to test the membrane alone; all contact parts, including O-rings, housing, and end caps, must be included. It is often the non-membrane components (such as O-rings) that are most prone to compatibility problems.

blocks.zh: 化學相容性測試就像在買新的保鮮盒裝酸性食物（如番茄醬、醋）之前：你不只需要知道盒體材質耐不耐酸，還要確認蓋子的矽膠密封圈不會被腐蝕、卡扣不會變脆斷裂。濾膜製造商的相容性表就像保鮮盒包裝上的「適用食材」列表 -- 它只是起點。如果你要裝的是一種特殊的辣椒醬（專屬藥品配方），你可能需要自己做實際測試才能放心。
blocks.en: Chemical compatibility testing is like buying a new food storage container for acidic foods (such as ketchup or vinegar): you need to know not only whether the container body resists acid, but also whether the silicone gasket in the lid will be corroded and whether the latches will become brittle and snap. The manufacturer's compatibility chart is like the "suitable foods" list on the container's packaging -- it is only a starting point. If what you want to store is a special chili sauce (a proprietary drug formulation), you may need to run your own actual tests to be confident.

blocks.zh: 多測試方法組合的必要性：原文明確建議使用「多種測試的組合」，因為單一測試可能無法檢測到微妙的不相容性。例如：
blocks.en: The need for a combination of test methods: The source text explicitly recommends using a "combination of tests", because a single test may not detect subtle incompatibilities. For example:

blocks.zh: 完整性測試可能通過，但 SEM 顯示膜表面已有微觀損傷
blocks.en: The integrity test may pass, yet SEM shows microscopic damage on the membrane surface

blocks.zh: 流速沒有變化，但 NVR（不揮發性殘留物）顯著增加，代表有物質溶出
blocks.en: The flow rate may be unchanged, yet nonvolatile residue (NVR) increases significantly, indicating that material is being released

blocks.zh: 拉伸強度下降表示材料正在降解，即使其他指標看起來正常
blocks.en: A decrease in tensile strength indicates that the material is degrading, even when other indicators look normal

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼化學相容性評估是一個綜合性的、多維度的評估過程。
blocks.en: This is why chemical compatibility assessment is a comprehensive, multi-dimensional process.

blocks.zh: 為什麼化學相容性測試需要在實際製程條件（溫度、接觸時間、流速）下進行，而不是只用室溫靜態浸泡？
blocks.en: Why must chemical compatibility testing be performed under actual process conditions (temperature, contact time, flow rate) rather than only static soaking at room temperature?

blocks.zh: 某客戶的藥品配方含有 20% 乙醇。從化學相容性的角度，你會特別關注濾器的哪些組件？為什麼？
blocks.en: A client's drug formulation contains 20% ethanol. From a chemical compatibility standpoint, which components of the filter would you pay particular attention to, and why?

blocks.zh: 4.7 Operational Ranges 4.7 操作範圍
blocks.en: 4.7 Operational Ranges

blocks.zh: Differential Pressure (差壓)：濾膜上游與下游之間的壓力差。差壓太高可能損壞濾膜結構，導致完整性失敗；差壓太低則流速不足。製造商會提供在不同溫度下的最大允許差壓。
blocks.en: Differential Pressure: The pressure difference between the upstream and downstream sides of the filter. Too high a differential pressure may damage the membrane structure and cause integrity failure; too low a differential pressure gives insufficient flow. The manufacturer provides the maximum allowable differential pressure at different temperatures.

blocks.zh: Operational Range vs. Validated Parameters（操作範圍 vs. 驗證參數）：這是一個關鍵區分 --
blocks.en: Operational Range vs. Validated Parameters: This is a key distinction --

blocks.zh: 操作範圍：製造商說「這個濾膜可以在 X 溫度、Y 壓力下使用」-- 這是通用的硬體極限
blocks.en: Operational range: The manufacturer says "this filter can be used at X temperature and Y pressure" -- this is a general hardware limit

blocks.zh: 驗證參數：你在自己的製程中，經過細菌攔截驗證後確認的實際可用參數範圍 -- 通常比操作範圍更窄
blocks.en: Validated parameters: The actual usable parameter range that you have confirmed in your own process through bacterial retention validation -- usually narrower than the operational range

blocks.zh: Pressure-Pulsation Cycles (壓力脈動循環)：模擬實際操作中壓力的波動變化（如泵浦造成的脈動），測試濾膜在反覆壓力變化下的機械穩定性。
blocks.en: Pressure-Pulsation Cycles: Simulate the pressure fluctuations seen in actual operation (such as pulsation caused by pumps) to test the mechanical stability of the filter under repeated pressure changes.

blocks.zh: 操作範圍和驗證參數的區別就像汽車的設計時速和你在特定道路上的安全駕駛速度：車廠說這輛車最高時速可達 250 km/h（操作範圍），但在你家附近的山路上，經過實際測試後，安全速度可能只有 80 km/h（驗證參數）。超過這個速度不一定會翻車，但你無法保證安全 -- 因為你只驗證到 80 km/h。同理，濾膜製造商的操作範圍是「硬體不會壞」的極限，但你的「除菌保證」只在你驗證過的參數範圍內有效。
blocks.en: The difference between the operational range and validated parameters is like a car's design speed versus the safe speed on a particular road: the manufacturer says the car can reach 250 km/h (operational range), but on the mountain road near your home, after actual testing, the safe speed may be only 80 km/h (validated parameters). Exceeding that speed does not necessarily mean a crash, but you cannot guarantee safety -- because you have only validated up to 80 km/h. Likewise, the filter manufacturer's operational range is the limit at which the "hardware will not fail", but your "sterility assurance" is valid only within the parameter range you have validated.

blocks.zh: 溫度與壓力的交互作用：這是一個常被忽略的重點。最大允許差壓通常會隨溫度升高而降低。例如，某濾膜在 25°C 時最大差壓是 5 bar，但在 80°C 時可能只有 2.5 bar。如果你在高溫條件下過濾卻使用了常溫的壓力限制，可能會損壞濾膜。
blocks.en: Interaction of temperature and pressure: This is an often overlooked point. The maximum allowable differential pressure usually decreases as temperature rises. For example, a filter may have a maximum differential pressure of 5 bar at 25°C but only 2.5 bar at 80°C. If you filter at high temperature but apply the room-temperature pressure limit, you may damage the filter.

blocks.zh: SIP（就地滅菌）的極端條件：SIP 過程中的高溫（通常 121-134°C）和蒸汽壓力對濾膜是最嚴苛的考驗。滅菌溫度限制和操作溫度限制可能不同 -- 務必區分。
blocks.en: Extreme conditions of SIP (steam-in-place): The high temperature (usually 121-134°C) and steam pressure during SIP are the most severe test for the filter. The sterilization temperature limit and the operating temperature limit may differ -- be sure to distinguish them.

blocks.zh: 流速影響因素：
blocks.en: Factors affecting flow rate:

blocks.zh:
Flow Rate = f(ΔP, A_eff, μ, T, d_pore, d_inlet/outlet)

其中：
  ΔP    = 差壓 (Differential Pressure)
  A_eff = 有效過濾面積 (EFA)
  μ     = 液體黏度 (隨溫度變化)
  T     = 溫度 (影響黏度和最大差壓)
  d_pore = 孔徑大小
  d_inlet/outlet = 外殼進出口口徑

注意：溫度升高 → 黏度降低 → 流速增加
      但同時 → 最大允許差壓降低 → 操作窗口縮小
blocks.en:
Flow Rate = f(ΔP, A_eff, μ, T, d_pore, d_inlet/outlet)

Where:
  ΔP    = Differential Pressure
  A_eff = Effective Filtration Area (EFA)
  μ     = liquid viscosity (varies with temperature)
  T     = temperature (affects viscosity and maximum differential pressure)
  d_pore = pore size
  d_inlet/outlet = housing inlet/outlet diameter

Note: temperature rises → viscosity falls → flow rate increases
      but at the same time → maximum allowable differential pressure falls → operating window narrows

blocks.zh: 你的製程在 60°C 下過濾高黏度蛋白質溶液。在選擇操作壓力時，你需要考量哪些互相矛盾的因素？如何找到最佳操作點？
blocks.en: Your process filters a high-viscosity protein solution at 60°C. In choosing the operating pressure, which conflicting factors do you need to consider? How would you find the optimal operating point?

blocks.zh: 為什麼原文特別提到「forward and reverse differential pressure limits」？在什麼情況下會出現反向差壓？這對濾膜完整性有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does the source text specifically mention "forward and reverse differential pressure limits"? Under what circumstances can reverse differential pressure occur? What risk does it pose to filter integrity?

blocks.zh: 4.8 Shelf Life and Shipping Studies 4.8 儲存效期與運輸研究
blocks.en: 4.8 Shelf Life and Shipping Studies

blocks.zh: Shelf Life (保存期限)：濾膜在製造商建議的儲存條件下，能維持其品質特性和性能規格的期間。超過保存期限的濾膜不應使用於藥品製造。
blocks.en: Shelf Life: The period during which the filter, under the manufacturer's recommended storage conditions, maintains its quality attributes and performance specifications. Filters beyond their shelf life should not be used in drug manufacturing.

blocks.zh: Sterility Claim (無菌聲明)：經 gamma 或 x-ray 輻射滅菌的濾器具有「預滅菌」聲明，此聲明有時效性 -- 因為包裝材料會隨時間老化，可能喪失無菌屏障功能。因此這類濾器一定有明確的有效期。
blocks.en: Sterility Claim: Filters sterilized by gamma or x-ray irradiation carry a "pre-sterilized" claim. This claim is time-limited because the packaging materials age over time and may lose their sterile barrier function. These filters therefore always have a defined expiry period.

blocks.zh: Shipping Validation (運輸驗證)：依據 ISTA 或 ASTM D4169 等標準，模擬運輸過程中的振動、跌落、壓縮等風險，確保濾器在送達使用者手中時仍完好無損。
blocks.en: Shipping Validation: Based on standards such as ISTA or ASTM D4169, risks such as vibration, drop, and compression during transport are simulated to ensure that the filter is still intact when it reaches the user.

blocks.zh: 濾器的保存期限管理就像超市食品的有效期：牛奶（經輻射滅菌的囊式濾器）有明確的有效日期，過期就不能喝；罐頭（未預滅菌的不鏽鋼濾芯）保存期限較長，但仍然有限制。而運輸驗證就像網購易碎品的包裝測試 -- 供應商必須確保產品能承受快遞運輸過程中的各種碰撞和擠壓，安全送到你手上。
blocks.en: Managing filter shelf life is like managing expiry dates on supermarket food: milk (an irradiation-sterilized capsule filter) has a definite expiry date and cannot be drunk after it passes; canned goods (non-pre-sterilized stainless steel cartridges) keep longer, but are still limited. Shipping validation is like packaging tests for fragile items bought online -- the supplier must make sure the product can withstand the knocks and squeezing of courier transport and reach you safely.

blocks.zh: CDMO 庫存管理的注意事項：
blocks.en: Inventory management considerations for CDMOs:

blocks.zh: 先進先出 (FIFO)：嚴格執行物料輪替，避免過期報廢
blocks.en: First in, first out (FIFO): Enforce strict material rotation to avoid scrapping expired stock

blocks.zh: 儲存條件監控：溫度、濕度超出範圍可能加速材料老化，縮短實際保存期限
blocks.en: Storage condition monitoring: Temperature or humidity excursions may accelerate material aging and shorten the actual shelf life

blocks.zh: 收貨檢驗：進貨時應檢查包裝完整性，確認運輸過程中未受損
blocks.en: Receiving inspection: Check packaging integrity on receipt to confirm that nothing was damaged in transit

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌濾器的特殊管理：這些濾器的有效期通常比未滅菌濾器短，需要更積極的庫存管理
blocks.en: Special management of irradiation-sterilized filters: These filters usually have a shorter expiry than non-sterilized filters and require more active inventory management

blocks.zh: 在多產品 CDMO 中，不同客戶可能指定不同品牌/型號的濾器，庫存品項繁多 -- 過期報廢是實際且常見的成本浪費。
blocks.en: In a multi-product CDMO, different clients may specify different filter brands/models, so there are many inventory items -- scrapping of expired stock is a real and common source of wasted cost.

blocks.zh: 供應鏈策略：COVID-19 疫情期間，全球單次使用組件供應鏈嚴重中斷，許多藥廠面臨濾器缺貨危機。建議 CDMO 採取：
blocks.en: Supply chain strategy: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the global supply chain for single-use components was severely disrupted, and many drug manufacturers faced filter shortages. CDMOs are advised to:

blocks.zh: 建立安全庫存（但要平衡過期風險）
blocks.en: Establish safety stock (while balancing the risk of expiry)

blocks.zh: 驗證至少兩個供應商的替代濾器
blocks.en: Validate alternative filters from at least two suppliers

blocks.zh: 與供應商建立長期合約和優先供貨協議
blocks.en: Establish long-term contracts and priority supply agreements with suppliers

blocks.zh: 考慮 consignment stock（寄售庫存）模式降低資金占壓
blocks.en: Consider a consignment stock model to reduce tied-up capital

blocks.zh: 如果一批 gamma 滅菌的囊式濾器在倉庫中被發現儲存溫度曾超過建議上限（但仍在保存期限內），你會如何處理？可以直接使用嗎？
blocks.en: A lot of gamma-sterilized capsule filters is found in the warehouse to have been stored at a temperature that exceeded the recommended upper limit (but is still within its shelf life). How would you handle it? Can it be used directly?

blocks.zh: 從供應鏈韌性 (supply chain resilience) 的角度，使用 SUS 濾器系統相比傳統不鏽鋼系統有什麼額外的風險？如何緩解？
blocks.en: From the perspective of supply chain resilience, what additional risks does a single-use filter system carry compared with a traditional stainless steel system? How can they be mitigated?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 責任劃分明確：濾膜製造商負責確效 (Q) 和批次放行 (L)，使用者負責製程驗證 (V) 和額外評估 (E)。Table 4.1-1🔍 是最重要的責任分工參考表。
blocks.en: Clear division of responsibilities: The filter manufacturer is responsible for qualification (Q) and lot release (L); the user is responsible for process validation (V) and additional evaluation (E). Table 4.1-1🔍 is the most important reference table for the division of responsibilities.

blocks.zh: 濾膜設計影響性能：褶皺密度決定 EFA（有效過濾面積），進而影響流速和處理量。Scale-up 時須注意 PD 階段與量產階段濾器幾何設計的差異。
blocks.en: Filter design affects performance: Pleat density determines EFA (effective filtration area), which in turn affects flow rate and throughput. During scale-up, pay attention to differences in filter geometry between the PD stage and the production stage.

blocks.zh: SUS 的雙面性：一次性使用系統消除了清洗驗證和交叉污染風險，但帶來了供應鏈依賴、廢棄物管理和 E&L 評估的新挑戰。
blocks.en: The two faces of SUS: Single-use systems eliminate cleaning validation and cross-contamination risk, but bring new challenges in supply chain dependence, waste management, and E&L assessment.

blocks.zh: E&L 是層層遞進的：先做可萃取物 (Extractables) 研究建立最壞情況基線，再根據風險評估決定是否需要可溶出物 (Leachables) 研究。預沖洗可有效降低兩者的水平。
blocks.en: E&L is a layered, progressive process: First perform an extractables study to establish a worst-case baseline, then decide through risk assessment whether a leachables study is needed. Preflushing can effectively reduce the levels of both.

blocks.zh: 化學相容性需全面評估：必須測試整個裝置（不只是膜材），使用多種測試方法的組合，在實際製程條件下進行。
blocks.en: Chemical compatibility requires a comprehensive assessment: The entire device must be tested (not just the membrane), using a combination of test methods, under actual process conditions.

blocks.zh: 操作範圍 ≠ 驗證參數：製造商的操作範圍是硬體極限，使用者的驗證參數（來自細菌攔截驗證）才是除菌保證的依據。
blocks.en: Operational range ≠ validated parameters: The manufacturer's operational range is a hardware limit; the user's validated parameters (from bacterial retention validation) are the basis for sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 保存期限管理不可忽視：尤其是 gamma/x-ray 滅菌的濾器有明確有效期，需嚴格執行 FIFO 和儲存條件監控。
blocks.en: Shelf life management cannot be ignored: In particular, gamma/x-ray sterilized filters have a defined expiry period, so FIFO and storage condition monitoring must be strictly enforced.

blocks.zh: 決策層級再次確認：所有選擇（材質、型式、供應商）最終都回歸到：無菌保證 > 產品 CQA > 商業彈性的優先順序。
blocks.en: The decision hierarchy reconfirmed: All choices (material, format, supplier) ultimately come back to the order of priority: sterility assurance > product CQAs > commercial flexibility.
